hints.title: Representative Elements
hints.text: Each unique category can be represented by its first discovered member.

hints.title: Comparing with Known Categories
hints.text: For each new item, query the helper method against previously retained category representatives.

hints.title: New Category Addition
hints.text: If the current item does not share a category with any established representative, register it as a new representative.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Query helper method against known category representatives to minimize API calls.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Querying all pairs without tracking unique representatives uses too many helper API calls.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n * c) time where c is the number of distinct categories, and O(c) space for representatives.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Minimize helper queries by testing only against canonical group representatives.
